name: gh-resolve
description: Recover a blocked GitHub PR: red required checks, a branch with conflicts, or a head behind its base.

interface.shortDescription: Unblock a stuck GitHub pull request
interface.longDescription: gh-resolve owns one axis of the PR lifecycle: getting a blocked pull request back to mergeable. GitHub greys the merge button for three reasons, and this plugin has one skill per reason. ci-fail reads the failing required checks' logs, finds the root cause, fixes it locally, re-runs the same command CI ran, and only then fast-forward pushes and removes the CI fail label - it never blind-retries a job and never pushes while local checks are red. conflict rebases the head onto its base, walks each conflicting file with the user rather than guessing, and pushes with --force-with-lease. outdated handles the easy case: the base moved but nothing conflicts, so it clean-rebases, force-with-lease pushes, and hands off to conflict the moment a conflict appears. Two of the three rewrite published history, so their guard rails - no plain --force, no silent re-rebase after a rejected lease, no run on the default branch - are part of the skills, not advice.
defaultPrompt: This PR's CI is red - find out why and fix it.
PR 1402 has conflicts. Rebase it onto main.
